questions.explain: AND keeps a bit only where both bits are 1. The mask 11110000 keeps the top four bits and zeroes the rest, giving 11000000.

questions.stem: How many different values can 6 bits hold?
questions.explain: Each bit doubles the count, so 6 bits give 2⁶ = 64 patterns.

questions.stem: A subnet has 256 addresses and 192 are in use. What percentage of the addresses is free?
A TCP segment carries 1000 bytes of data and a 20-byte TCP header. It is placed in an IP packet with a 20-byte IP header. How many bytes is the IP packet?
questions.explain: Each layer wraps the data from the layer above with its own header: 1000 + 20 + 20 = 1040 bytes.
